focus: Audit the local packet and official Designer/Bridge App surface: page, mode, branch, component view, selection, element tree, components and their props/variants/slots/metadata, styles, variable modes, and breakpoints.
noveltyJustification: Eight distinct Designer/Bridge packet gaps were newly identified by triangulating official Webflow documentation, the official repository README, and exact local action/card anchors.
ruledOut: CMS, publishing, scripts, forms, localization, sites, assets, webhooks, Enterprise, AI, WHTML, utility tools, and rate limits were deferred by the one-focus prompt
The unavailable guessed hosted documentation path was not retried verbatim; canonical official MCP documentation and the repository README were used instead

title: Canvas navigation/state classification is inconsistent
recommendation: Separate Bridge-bound state/navigation mutations from site-tree draft writes and align class/gate labels with the action inventory.

title: Element-tree query semantics are too concise
recommendation: Document query dimensions, target-id shape, and a discovery-to-mutation example.

title: Style class/combo-class/raw-CSS semantics are omitted
recommendation: Add class identity, combo-class, raw-CSS, and style read-back guidance.

title: Breakpoint behavior lacks current-breakpoint reconciliation
recommendation: Reconcile hosted current-breakpoint capability with the exposed action inventory and add version-qualified selection/verification coverage.

title: Branch merge lifecycle is underspecified
recommendation: Document the supported branch lifecycle and explicitly qualify merge as outside the MCP surface if no merge action exists.

title: Component-variants feature card contradicts the action reference
recommendation: Rewrite the card from the actual variant action table and add deterministic read/update/read-back testing.

title: Component metadata, props, and slots lack operational rules
recommendation: Add metadata fields, prop constraints/defaults, slot validation, and read-back examples.

title: Variable-mode value and verification semantics are thin
recommendation: Add a mode/value/binding matrix and verify mode-specific style results without claiming an unexposed active-mode operation.
